items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: Sonny Payne would take his solo with Basie that time... he was a trick drummer.

ctx.x: In your mind, you're hearing the sound of a tune. I'll tell you, what you're saying was when Sonny Payne would take his solo with Basie that time, and they would do that 'Old Man River.' Now, he would do the rolling, but he would roll practically through the whole solo. But it was through the rhythmetic pattern of the whole tune. You could follow up 'Old Man River.'
